# DETAIL DESIGN DOCUMENT
## Multi-Source Customer Master Data Consolidation to Snowflake

**Document Version:** 1.0  
**Last Updated:** 2024-01-15  
**Classification:** Technical Design  

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

This document provides comprehensive technical specifications for consolidating customer master data from three heterogeneous sources (SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, PostgreSQL DW) into a unified Snowflake customer dimension table. The solution addresses schema conflicts, data type mismatches, duplicate records, and implements enterprise-grade data quality controls.

**Key Objectives:**
- Achieve single source of truth for customer data
- Reconcile conflicting schemas and data formats
- Eliminate duplicate customer records
- Maintain referential integrity and audit trail
- Enable dimensional analytics on standardized customer attributes

---

## 2. ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW

### 2.1 High-Level Data Flow

```

│                      SOURCE SYSTEMS                              │
├──────────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────────────────┤

│  (Full Load)     │  (CDC - Daily)   │   (CDC - Hourly)         │
└────────┬─────────┴────────┬─────────┴──────────┬────────────────┘
         │                  │                    │
         ▼                  ▼                    ▼

│  SAP Extract     │ SFDC Extract     │ PostgreSQL Extract       │
│  (Snowflake      │ (Snowflake       │ (Snowflake STG)          │
│   STG_SAP)       │  STG_SALESFORCE) │                          │
└────────┬─────────┴────────┬─────────┴──────────┬────────────────┘
         │                  │                    │
         └──────────────────┼────────────────────┘
                            ▼
         ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
         │  CONSOLIDATION LAYER             │
         ├──────────────────────────────────┤
         │ • Fuzzy Matching (Dedup)         │
         │ • Schema Mapping                 │
         │ • Conflict Resolution            │

         └───────────────┬──────────────────┘
                         ▼
         ┌──────────────────────────────────┐

# DETAILED DESIGN DOCUMENT
## DB to DB Data Integration: Oracle OLTP → Snowflake Data Warehouse

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Project:** Oracle OLTP to Snowflake DW Migration
**Type:** Database-to-Database (DB to DB) ETL
**Scope:** Customer dimension and sales fact tables with Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) logic
**Frequency:** Daily incremental loads
**Target SLA:** < 4 hours nightly window

---

## 2. DETAILED ARCHITECTURE & WORKFLOW

### 2.1 End-to-End Data Flow

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ SOURCE LAYER (Oracle OLTP)                                          │
│ ├─ CUSTOMER_ID, CUST_NAME, STATUS (Customer Table)                │
│ ├─ ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ORDER_DATE (Order Table)  │
│ └─ [Daily Change Detection via Timestamps/Version Control]         │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                 │ [Oracle CDC or Query-based Extract]
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ EXTRACTION LAYER                                                    │
│ ├─ Query Source Tables with WHERE modified_date >= last_run        │
│ ├─ Apply Pre-filters (Active records only)                         │
│ ├─ Hash source records for change detection                        │
│ └─ Log extraction metrics (row counts, timestamps)                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                 │ [Incremental Dataset]
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STAGING LAYER (Snowflake stg_customer_raw, stg_order_raw)          │
│ ├─ Load raw extracted data (truncate & reload OR upsert)           │
│ ├─ Add technical columns:                                          │
│ │  - stg_load_date (current timestamp)                             │
│ │  - stg_source_hash (MD5 hash of data)                            │
│ │  - stg_row_status (NEW, CHANGED, UNCHANGED, DELETED)             │
